title: Jr Partnerships Manager
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Market Data Infrastructure Engineer (LATAM)
description:

Company Description

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Our Client

Our client is one of the world's leading investment banks, founded in the 19th century, offers a broad range of services, including investment banking, securities trading, and asset management. It specializes in advising on mergers, acquisitions, and capital-raising activities for major corporations and governments. Known for its strong presence in global financial markets, the firm provides market-making and trading services across various asset classes. It has earned a reputation for shaping the financial landscape on Wall Street and beyond. The organization is also committed to philanthropy and sustainability through its various initiatives and programs.


Role Description

We are looking for a skilled professional to join our Market Data Infrastructure team, focused on managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience

• Experience with Market Data Thomson Reuters Enterprise Platform (TREP) or Refinitiv Real-Time Distribution System (RTDS) and DACS .

• Good understanding of Market Data platforms e.g. Refinitiv, Bloomberg, direct feed providers.

• Proficient with Linux/ Windows operating systems and network level tuning and editing scripts - preferred scripting language: Bash/Python.

  • Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.
  • Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must
  • Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices
  • Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:
  • Geneos ITRS
  • EXEGY (formerly Wombat/Vela)
  • Market Data API
  • AWS ECS, AWS VPC, including VPC Endpoints


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented company
  • Remote work, or Hybrid based on candidates’ preferences
  • Continuous development and training opportunities
  • A competitive salary package with additional social benefits
  • Interesting and challenging tasks
  • The opportunity to work in an international and multicultural environment
  • Regular team events
  • Long-term career prospects

description:

We are building a team of evaluators to assess the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This role focuses on ensuring responses are not only linguistically accurate, but also culturally relevant and aligned with regional nuances across Brazil.

  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve model performance

  • Collaborating closely with language specialists, team leads, and QA leads to produce the best possible work

title: Client Experience Specialist
description:
Overview


AdaptCFO is a fast-growing outsourced accounting and finance firm supporting small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S.


We are hiring a Client Experience Specialist to own the day-to-day execution of client delivery, billing accuracy, and operational coordination across the business.


This role sits at the center of our organization, working directly with clients, our accounting team, and leadership to ensure:


  • Deliverables are completed on time and within budget
  • Billing is accurate and aligned with work performed
  • Clients are supported and retained
  • Operational processes run efficiently as we scale


Success in this role means creating a consistent, reliable client experience while reducing internal bottlenecks and identifying opportunities for growth.


This is a high-impact, hands-on role with a clear path into leadership as the company grows.




Key Responsibilities



Client Experience & Communication


  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Manage client communication, follow-ups, and requests
  • Support and help lead client check-ins and QBRs
  • Proactively identify and resolve client issues




Delivery & Budget Accountability


  • Track monthly deliverables across bookkeeping, controller, and CFO services
  • Ensure deadlines are met (10–15 business day close target)
  • Monitor team utilization and ensure work stays within budget
  • Flag risks early and drive resolution




Billing & Revenue Accuracy


  • Assist with client billing and invoice preparation
  • Ensure billing aligns with scope, deliverables, and hours worked
  • Identify underbilling, missed charges, and scope creep
  • Help maintain consistent and scalable billing processes




Upsells & Account Growth


  • Identify opportunities for additional services (CFO, cleanup, add-ons)
  • Surface opportunities to leadership and support execution
  • Ensure clients are properly scoped as they grow




Onboarding


  • Support onboarding of new clients
  • Coordinate data collection, access, and system setup
  • Ensure a smooth transition into recurring workflows




Team Coordination


  • Work closely with offshore accounting team (Philippines) and U.S.-based CFOs
  • Maintain clear communication and accountability across teams
  • Identify performance gaps and escalate when needed




Operations & Process Improvement


  • Help build and refine SOPs across onboarding, delivery, and billing
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements
  • Support operational structure as the company scales




What Success Looks Like


  • Clients are satisfied, retained, and not escalating issues
  • Monthly closes are consistently on time
  • Work is delivered within budgeted hours
  • Billing is accurate, complete, and timely
  • Upsell opportunities are identified and acted on
  • Leadership is not pulled into day-to-day execution




Qualifications


  • 2–5+ years of experience in operations, client services, or service-based businesses
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable managing multiple clients and priorities
  • Ability to hold team members accountable in a professional way
  • Experience in accounting, finance, or professional services is a strong plus
  • Experience with tools like QuickBooks, HubSpot, or similar platforms is a plus




Compensation


  • Base Salary: $24,000 – $42,000 USD (depending on experience)



Performance Bonus


  • Annual bonus tied to client retention
  • Additional upside tied to upsell support and revenue growth




Why AdaptCFO


  • Fully remote team
  • High ownership role with direct impact on the business
  • Clear path to leadership as the company grows
  • Exposure to U.S.-based clients and finance operations
  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Exposure to ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
  • Hands‑on experience supporting at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Experience working in or alongside Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills for troubleshooting complex issues
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow

  • Manter a tecnologia atual.

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang
  • TDD – metodologia de testes

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior - Oracle Cloud (OCI)
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior - Oracle Cloud (OCI)


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro, , integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

description:
AI Engineer (LLMs, RAG & Agents)


Estamos em busca de um AI Engineer para atuar na evolução da nossa plataforma com foco na construção de sistemas inteligentes baseados em LLMs, agentes e bases de conhecimento.


Essa pessoa fará parte do time de engenharia e será responsável por desenvolver soluções de IA aplicadas ao produto, integrando modelos de linguagem com dados reais, sistemas internos e fluxos de negócio.


Nosso objetivo é construir uma plataforma orientada a inteligência artificial, com uso de RAG, agentes e múltiplas bases de conhecimento (relacionais, vetoriais e grafos), aplicadas a contextos educacionais e corporativos.


Não buscamos um perfil acadêmico ou focado em treinamento de modelos. Buscamos alguém que saiba transformar IA em produto real.


O que você vai fazer:


  • Desenvolver funcionalidades baseadas em LLMs integradas à plataforma
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Estruturar e evoluir bases de conhecimento (dados estruturados, vetoriais e grafos)
  • Construir e orquestrar agentes e fluxos de execução (tools, multi-agents, etc.)
  • Integrar IA com sistemas existentes (APIs, banco de dados, serviços internos)
  • Trabalhar na qualidade das respostas (avaliação, melhoria contínua, contexto)

  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia na evolução da arquitetura da plataforma


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com uso de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • Experiência com construção de RAG e uso de embeddings
  • Experiência com integração de IA em aplicações reais (não apenas protótipos)
  • Conhecimento em APIs, backend e integração entre sistemas
  • Capacidade de estruturar e trabalhar com diferentes tipos de dados
  • Experiência com debugging e evolução de sistemas em produção
  • Mentalidade de engenharia (performance, custo, confiabilidade)


Stack e Tecnologias (IA e Dados):


  • LLMs e APIs de IA (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Bases vetoriais (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares)
  • Bases de grafos e conhecimento (Neo4j ou similares)
  • Orquestração de agentes (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno ou abordagens próprias)

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
  • Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.

  • Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
  • Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
  • Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
  • Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.

  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

Remoto | Grupo SBF (Centauro & Nike Brasil (FISIA))

Se você tem paixão por formar times de alta performance, toma decisões baseadas em dados e sabe equilibrar visão técnica e foco em pessoas, essa vaga pode ser sua próxima jornada!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em posições de liderança à frente de mais de um contexto;
  • Histórico de entregas com impacto real (eficiência, performance, redução de custo ou aumento de satisfação);
  • Familiaridade com métricas de times de engenharia (DORA Metrics ou similares);
  • Experiência com sistemas críticos e em escala ;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e empática ;
  • Capacidade de liderar e desenvolver times diversos , promovendo um ambiente seguro , colaborativo e de crescimento ;
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em resolver problemas complexos com inovação e senso de urgência;
  • Experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de software;
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de software, sistemas distribuídos e metodologias ágeis.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar times de engenharia , garantindo entregas estratégicas com qualidade e alinhamento aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Atuar próximo a Produto, Design, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir sinergia e integração nas entregas;
  • Ser responsável por desenvolvimento de pessoas , feedbacks, mentoring e formação de cultura;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas relevantes , com foco em escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance;
  • Gerenciar orçamento, riscos e priorizações , com capacidade de adaptação e liderança em momentos de crise;
  • Promover boas práticas de engenharia , cultura de experimentação e aprendizagem contínua.


✨ Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior em e-commerce ou ambientes de larga escala;
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação organizacional ou melhoria contínua;
  • Publicações técnicas, participação em comunidades, eventos ou contribuições open source;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança (OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001) e atuação com Security Champions.


—

title: Technical Delivery Team Manager
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a global IT solutions provider and trusted Oracle Partner, is dedicated to transforming enterprises with innovative, scalable, and future-ready solutions. Headquartered in London, UK, with a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India, the company leverages a blend of expert business foresight and world-class technical talent. Specializing in Oracle Cloud and database technologies, MillionLogics offers a comprehensive range of services, including Data & AI, Cloud Solutions, IT Consulting, and Enterprise Applications. With a team of 45+ technology experts, MillionLogics is committed to delivering tailored, outcomes-driven solutions that help organizations thrive in the digital era. Learn more about their offerings at


Role Overview 

The Engineering Manager (EM) will be responsible for driving end-to-end delivery across multiple environments, ensuring timelines, quality, stakeholder communication, and execution discipline are maintained. This role will coordinate across PMs, QA, frontend, backend, data, and client-facing teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and with the expected quality.

The Engineering Manager will act as the central owner for delivery planning, risk management, issue escalation, resource coordination, and release readiness.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Own end-to-end delivery for assigned environments and ensure commitments are met
  • Create and manage delivery plans, timelines, trackers, and milestones
  • Align cross-functional teams (frontend, backend, QA, data, automation, PM) on priorities and dependencies
  • Track progress daily, identify delays early, and take corrective actions
  • Break down projects into phases with clear ownership and timelines
  • Manage risks, blockers, and bottlenecks; drive escalations and resolutions proactively
  • Coordinate with stakeholders and provide regular updates on progress, risks, and trade-offs
  • Ensure QA, data quality checks, automation, and documentation are complete before release
  • Conduct go/no-go reviews and ensure release readiness with all critical issues resolved
  • Track delivery metrics (timelines, defects, utilization, risks) and drive continuous improvement


Required skills

  • 8+ years of strong project and delivery management experience
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience with delivery planning, risk management, and escalation handling
  • Strong understanding of QA, engineering, and release processes
  • Ability to drive accountability and execution across teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, or similar


Preferred skills

  • Experience managing SaaS, workflow, enterprise, or RL environment projects
  • Familiarity with frontend, backend, QA, automation, and data workflows
  • Experience with resource planning and capacity management
  • Understanding of delivery metrics, harness reports, and quality dashboards
  • Experience working with global or client-facing teams


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Employment type  : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract :6 months (expected start date is next week)
  • Compensation : Competitive


How to Apply: Please send us your updated cv to with \"job ID: 72134\" as your email subject.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor .NET Core


⸻


Sobre o Wite Group / WiteTec

O Wite Group, por meio da WiteTec, é uma empresa orientada à construção de produtos digitais com impacto real no negócio. Atuamos com alto nível de responsabilidade técnica, foco em eficiência operacional e compromisso com entrega consistente em ambiente de produção. Não somos uma empresa de experimentação superficial — valorizamos profissionais que assumem ownership, tomam decisões e sustentam sistemas críticos com qualidade e previsibilidade.


⸻

Buscamos um desenvolvedor .NET Core com forte capacidade de execução, que saiba transformar demandas em soluções funcionais, escaláveis e seguras. O profissional será responsável por atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas em produção, com autonomia para propor melhorias e responsabilidade sobre o que entrega.


Não buscamos apenas alguém que “sabe programar”, mas alguém que resolve problemas reais, entende impacto de negócio e entrega com consistência.


⸻


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações utilizando .NET Core

• Garantir qualidade de código, legibilidade e manutenção a longo prazo

• Participar de decisões técnicas com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade

• Atuar na identificação e correção de problemas em ambiente produtivo

• Assumir responsabilidade direta por entregas, prazos e estabilidade do sistema


⸻


Requisitos técnicos (Hard Skills)

• Domínio prático de .NET Core e C#

• Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs REST

• Conhecimento sólido em banco de dados (SQL Server ou similar)

• Entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas (camadas, separação de responsabilidades)

• Experiência com versionamento de código (Git)

• Capacidade de debugar, identificar e resolver problemas reais em produção

• Noções de performance, segurança e boas práticas de desenvolvimento


⸻


Competências comportamentais (Soft Skills)

• Alto senso de responsabilidade (não terceiriza problema)

• Capacidade de execução sem depender de microgerenciamento

• Pensamento crítico e orientação à solução

• Organização e clareza na comunicação

• Maturidade para lidar com pressão e priorização

• Proatividade para identificar melhorias e agir


⸻


Observação final

Buscamos um profissional com alto nível de execução, que entrega, sustenta e evolui sistemas com responsabilidade real. Aqui, resultado prático é mais importante do que discurso técnico.

title: Social Media AI Content Creator
description:
We are first and foremost a great team full of ambitious and proactive individuals whose goal is to become the best professionals they can be and make Digital Silk a globally renowned digital agency. Our quest for excellence has resulted in our company’s growth and continuous need for outstanding team members.


We’re looking for a hands-on Social Media AI Content Creator who can combine strong social instincts with modern AI-enabled workflows to produce high-performing content at scale.


This role blends creative execution and performance thinking . You’ll create and ship social content consistently, support paid social execution, and use analytics to improve what we publish. You’ll collaborate closely with our design, content, and marketing teams, and you’ll be comfortable presenting insights internally and externally.


Must be an expert in the following:


  • Create social content across formats: short-form video concepts, carousels, static posts, story/reel scripts, captions, hooks, and CTAs using AI Tools and working with designers and video editors.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate production while maintaining strong brand voice, originality, and quality (ideation → drafts → refinement → variations).
  • Build and maintain a content pipeline: monthly themes, weekly plans, daily execution, and rapid-turnaround content when needed.
  • Drive measurable results from the assets you create. Engagement for Organic posts and conversions of ad creatives.
  • Repurpose long-form assets (blogs, case studies, webinars, podcasts) into high-performing social content.
  • Execute and optimize organic social publishing for client accounts: planning, scheduling, community-minded posting, and iteration based on performance.
  • Ensure each account follows clear brand guidelines (tone, voice, visuals) and platform best practices.
  • Collaborate with design and content teams to brief assets, refine creative direction, and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Work with tools like n8n, Google Veo, Sora, and Runway (including others) to create high performing Social Media content for our clients.
  • Work with internal senior leadership & clients to enable AI-first content workflows
  • Turn content produced from AI into high-quality, client-ready deliverables


Digital Silk is built upon the principles of self-betterment, excellence, proactivity, and teamwork. If you share our passion and values, and want to be challenged and thrive in your career, then you will fit right in.


Digital Silk offers competitive salaries, yearly growth opportunities AND company shares for all team members.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position as our headquarters are in the US. We do require team members to work from 8am to 5pm EST (with breaks) as our clients are in the US.


What we offer at Digital Silk:


  • A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth
  • Competitive pay, salary growth, and bonuses
  • Equity ownership in our company – share in profit upon company sale!
  • Challenging projects and opportunity to work with great team members
  • Work-from-home opportunity
  • 4 weeks paid time off


Requirements & Responsibilities:


  • Create organic & paid social content calendars in coordination with the design team
  • Set up social media campaigns on various platforms and optimize performance
  • Work with the social media team, provide ongoing training, and team improvements
  • Perform channel audits
  • Develop comprehensive social media strategies
  • Assist in sales pitches and on client calls
  • Create and present monthly reports with KPI’s
  • Superb English speaking and copywriting skills
  • Driven to get results and grow with the agency


We are a growing digital agency and are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Recruitment steps:


  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Have an interview with the Recruitment team
  • Receive a technical test
  • Have a technical interview with the Hiring Manager/s
  • Get feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
About The Product

At Boldin , we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence.

With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future.


About This Role

The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical authority responsible for defining Boldin’s data architecture, setting long-term technical strategy, and tackling our most complex data engineering challenges. This role shapes company-wide data standards, and partners with executive and cross-functional leaders to ensure our data platform scales with the business.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve long-term data architecture and vision
  • Design resilient and scalable data platform and pipelines
  • Set standards for data modeling, reliability, observability, and governance
  • Lead complex, high-risk technical initiatives and migrations
  • Influence tool selection, and technology adoption across the data stack
  • Elevate engineering excellence
  • Partner with leadership to align data strategy and business goals
  • Enable analytics, ML, and product use cases 1KPIS + Targets
  • Uptime: Consistently meets SLA for business-critical pipelines
  • Freshness: All Tier 1 datasets delivered within SLA
  • Delivery predictability: Majority of sprint commitments completed as planned
  • Cost optimization: Year-over-year efficiency improvement as data scales
  • Documentation: Full coverage for all production-grade assets


Qualifications

Technical Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering or related disciplines
  • Proficient in SQL, Python, or related languages
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP)
  • Strong experience with data warehouse, data lakes, and distributed systems
  • Strong experience with modern data stack (Athena, BigQuery, Glue, Spark, Dataproc, Kafka, Flink, dbt, Kestra, Fivetran or equivalent)
  • Proven ability to build and maintain production-grade ELT/ETL pipelines
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Cloud Composer)
  • Experience implementing data quality and observability frameworks
  • Performance and cost optimization in cloud warehouses
  • Good spoken English


Product & Business Partnership:

  • Experience supporting product analytics and experimentation
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data models
  • Strong ownership and accountability for SLAs


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with Kubernetes
  • Experience structuring data for ML or AI use cases
  • Familiarity with Amplitude or product event pipelines
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or fintech environment
  • Influencing technical direction without direct managerial authority


Benefits:

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Customer Success Pleno
description:
Sobre a Payfy

A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte.

Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.


O desafio

Você vai ser o ponto de contato estratégico dos nossos clientes — do onboarding ao crescimento contínuo. Sua missão é garantir que cada empresa da sua carteira use a plataforma de forma efetiva, identificando oportunidades de expansão e antecipando problemas antes que virem churns.

Essa não é uma posição para quem faz CS no piloto automático. É para quem usa IA para trabalhar mais rápido, se comunicar melhor e enxergar padrões antes que os dados gritem.


O que você vai fazer

  • Conduzir demonstrações e implantações de novos clientes, usando IA para personalizar apresentações e antecipar dúvidas com base no perfil de cada conta
  • Gerenciar carteira high touch com comunicação ativa e periódica, apoiada por automações e resumos gerados com IA
  • Mapear saúde dos clientes, identificar riscos de churn e oportunidades de expansão — usando dados e ferramentas de IA para acelerar análise
  • Registrar interações e manter CRM atualizado com agilidade, usando IA para estruturar notas e follow-ups



O que buscamos

  • Experiência em CS com foco em onboarding e carteiras high touch: sabe conduzir jornada do cliente do zero ao engajamento real
  • Uso de IA no trabalho: usa ferramentas como Claude, ChatGPT ou similares para escrever melhor, analisar mais rápido e automatizar etapas repetitivas. Não é IA por moda — é IA com propósito
  • Organização e agilidade: consegue gerenciar volume de clientes, demandas simultâneas e registros sem perder o fio da meada
  • Comunicação clara e direta: boa oratória, escrita objetiva e presença nas interações com o cliente
  • Senso de produto e negócio: entende o impacto do CS no resultado financeiro da empresa e do cliente



O que não buscamos

  • Quem faz CS só no relacionamento, sem interesse em dados, processos e melhoria contínua
  • Quem usa IA apenas para gerar textos genéricos, sem integrar ao processo real de trabalho
  • Perfis que precisam de muito contexto e direcionamento para tomar decisões simples



O que oferecemos

  • Contrato CLT — R$ 2.900 fixo + variável
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição — você escolhe
  • Assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiada pela empresa (após 3 meses)
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Wellhub + Conexa Saúde
  • Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível
  • Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e crescer junto com a tecnologia



Diversidade e Inclusão na Payfy

Você é livre para ser você. Valorizamos quem você quiser ser, independente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascêndência ou idade.


Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.

Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Analista de desenvolvimento de novos negócios II
description:
Descrição da vaga

SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Mapear e analisar oportunidades de projetos futuros no segmento de transmissão de energia.

  • Contribuir para a elaboração e atualização do planejamento estratégico da área de transmissão.
  • Estruturar novos negócios e apoiar a definição de estratégias de participação em projetos e leilões.
  • Realizar análises de mercado, incluindo avaliação de concorrência, tendências e oportunidades no setor.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação em Engenharia ou Economia.
  • Visão estratégica aplicada ao setor elétrico, com compreensão da dinâmica de expansão da transmissão.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento ou avaliação de projetos no segmento de transmissão de energia.
  • Conhecimento do modelo regulatório e do ambiente de negócios da transmissão no Brasil.
  • Domínio de ferramentas computacionais, com ênfase em:
  • Excel avançado
  • Estruturação e manipulação de bases de dados
  • Ferramentas de Business Intelligence (BI)

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência na análise de documentos setoriais relacionados à expansão da transmissão, como Relatórios R, PET/PELP, POTEE, PAR/PEL e editais de leilões.
  • Experiência em análise econômico-financeira de projetos.
  • Conhecimento na estruturação e estimativa de CAPEX e cronograma de projetos de transmissão.
  • Capacidade de condução e coordenação de projetos multidisciplinares.


Informações adicionais

Benefícios:


Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. Alguns dos benefícios que disponibilizamos estão disponíveis abaixo:

• Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;

• Plano Médico e Odontológico;

• Wellhub;

• Auxílio-creche;

• Auxílio-educacional;

Se esses benefícios e essa posição fazem sentido para você, inscreva-se já!

Resumo da vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) Fullstack Sênior que atue na construção de soluções end-to-end, contribuindo tanto no front-end quanto no back-end. Essa pessoa terá papel ativo na definição de arquitetura e na evolução da experiência do usuário, colaborando com times multidisciplinares para desenvolver aplicações escaláveis, performáticas e de alta qualidade. Modelar e gerenciar dados em bancos de dados orientados a documentos. Escrever e manter testes unitários e de integração em toda a stack. Contribuir com pipelines de CI/CD e garantir fluxos de deploy eficientes utilizando GitHub Actions. Trabalhar em conjunto com Produto, UX e Engenharia na entrega de soluções de alto impacto. Otimizar performance e assegurar compatibilidade entre plataformas. Realizar code reviews, apoiar o desenvolvimento do time e disseminar boas práticas. Manter documentação técnica atualizada e participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo.

Requisitos técnicos:

Experiência sólida (8+ anos) em desenvolvimento de software, atuando com front-end e back-end. Domínio de React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js e NestJS. Experiência na construção e consumo de APIs REST e no uso de bancos de dados de documentos. Vivência com arquitetura BFF. Experiência com testes automatizados (ex: Jest) e ferramentas de CI/CD, especialmente GitHub Actions. Conhecimento em acessibilidade, performance e design responsivo.

Requisitos desejáveis:

Experiência em ambientes globais, distribuídos e multiculturais. Vivência com metodologias ágeis e práticas modernas de desenvolvimento. Inglês avançado (nível B2/C1) para comunicação diária em ambiente global.

Diferenciais:

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.

title: Credit Risk Analyst
description:
Credit Risk Analyst — Acquisition & Online Lending

Full-time Contractor (PJ) | 100% Remote | US Central Time hours


⚠️ This is NOT an FP&A, Treasury, or Controller role. If your background is financial planning, accounting, or back-book portfolio management, this role is not a match.


Our US fintech client — an online consumer lender — is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst who owns the front end of the credit funnel. This means acquisition-side risk: designing risk tiers, sequencing underwriting decisions, managing approval/decline trade-offs at the top of funnel, and building the logic that determines who gets credit and at what terms — before any loan hits the books.


If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you.


What You'll Do

• Optimize risk tiers and underwriting sequences for online customer acquisition

• Analyze precision/recall trade-offs in credit decisioning models to balance approval volume and loss rates

• Support or develop dynamic acquisition pricing strategies tied to risk performance

• Design and refine multiple underwriting pathways (multi-path sequencing)

• Build and monitor rescue lane strategies to recover near-miss applicants

• Track and report on front-end risk KPIs: approval rate, take rate, early delinquency, cost per funded loan

• Work closely with data and product teams to improve decision engine logic


Requirements (Non Negotiable)

• 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment

• Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing

• Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English

• SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data

• Ability to work US Central Time hours (approx. 9am–6pm CT / 11am–8pm Brasília)


Nice to Have

• Experience with rescue lane management or near-miss recovery programs

• Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel

• Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration

• Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post-acquisition)

• Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance company


What We Offer

• PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates

• 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil

• US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights

• Direct exposure to a fast-growing US online lending operation

title: Salesforce Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring experienced Software Engineers  to join our team and build on the Salesforce platform. These are hands-on engineering roles — you will be writing code, designing solutions, and shipping features across a large, mature codebase. We are not looking for administrators or declarative-only builders; we need engineers who think in code and architecture.

We're hiring across both UI/Frontend  and Backend/Platform  specializations, and you'll work on a production Experience Cloud site built with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Bootstrap, supported by a robust backend of Apex services, integrations, and asynchronous processing.



What You'll Work On


Frontend / UI Engineers  will focus on:

  • Building and maintaining Lightning Web Components within an Experience Cloud site serving external users
  • Working with Bootstrap-based styling and responsive layouts alongside the LWC framework
  • Designing component architectures that are performant, accessible, and maintainable at scale
  • Integrating frontend components with Apex controllers, platform events, and real-time data flows

Backend / Platform Engineers  will focus on:

  • Designing and building Apex services, triggers, and automation across a complex data model
  • Implementing and maintaining asynchronous processing patterns including Queueable Apex, Batchable Apex, and Platform Events
  • Working with the Connect API and other Salesforce platform APIs
  • Building and supporting MuleSoft integrations for document processing and connectivity to external systems
  • Ensuring governor limit compliance, bulkification, and performance optimization across high-volume operations

All engineers  will contribute to code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.



Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline — we value a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and software engineering principles
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , with a meaningful portion spent writing code on the Salesforce platform (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Visualforce)
  • Demonstrated experience building large-scale applications  — you've worked in codebases with significant complexity, not just small apps or proof-of-concept projects
  • Experience building cloud-native or cloud-hosted applications  — you understand multi-tenant architecture, API-driven design, and the tradeoffs of building on a managed platform
  • Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools  (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) — you actively use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review, and you understand how to validate and guide AI-generated output effectively
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals : version control (Git), testing strategies, CI/CD, separation of concerns, and clean code practices



Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud  (Community Cloud) site development
  • Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC)  in production
  • Experience with MuleSoft  (Anypoint Platform, API-led connectivity, CloudHub)
  • Familiarity with Platform Events  and event-driven architecture on Salesforce
  • Experience with Batchable and Queueable Apex  patterns for high-volume data processing
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce Connect API
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II  (valued but not required — we care more about what you can build than what you've passed)
  • Experience with Bootstrap  or similar CSS frameworks in the context of LWC development
  • Familiarity with document processing pipelines and integration patterns

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)
description:
Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)

Replay API / LeetGaming.pro (Brazil-based, fully open-source core)


Role Summary

As a Backend Go Developer, you will design, build, and scale the core Go backend that powers LeetGaming.pro’s Replay API — the engine behind AI-driven game replay analysis, matchmaking, tournaments, and player performance evaluation for competitive titles (CS2, Valorant, and more). You will work directly on parsing massive volumes of replay files, storing and querying structured data, running background workers, and delivering secure, high-performance REST/RPC/WebSocket APIs that serve gamers, teams, and tournament organizers worldwide.


What Success Looks Like

  • You ship production-ready features (new game parsers, event handlers, scoring systems, or ML integrations) that are fast, reliable, and easy to maintain.
  • The platform scales smoothly as replay volume grows, with clean code, comprehensive tests, and zero-downtime deployments via Docker + Kubernetes.
  • You actively contribute to the open-source repository, improve architecture and security (including post-quantum cryptography), and help the team move from prototype to production launch.
  • Stakeholders (founders, esports partners, and players) see tangible improvements in data accuracy, query speed, and new capabilities like MMR wallets or AI talent scoring.


How This Role Fits into the Organization

Replay API is the central backend of LeetGaming.pro. Your work directly enables the entire product: every replay upload, match analysis, tournament bracket, and player insight flows through the services you build. You will collaborate closely with the small, high-impact team (currently led by the project’s main contributor) and influence the product roadmap while keeping the entire stack open-source under MIT.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, RPC endpoints, and secure WebSocket services in Go to handle replay ingestion, search, and real-time event streaming.
  • Develop and optimize replay parsers and background workers (OCR, oracle, game-discovery, etc.) that extract player actions, statistics, and events from multiple game formats.
  • Model, store, and query large-scale replay data using MongoDB with efficient indexing, aggregation pipelines, and the repository pattern.
  • Build and maintain matchmaking, tournament, MMR, and Solana wallet integration logic.
  • Integrate and expose machine-learning models that evaluate player performance and generate talent scores.
  • Ensure high availability and scalability by containerizing services with Docker and deploying on Kubernetes.
  • Write unit/integration tests, enforce code quality with golangci-lint, and participate in CI/CD pipelines that publish images to GitHub Container Registry.
  • Harden security (RID token auth, post-quantum cryptography, input validation) across all services.
  • Document APIs (OpenAPI) and contribute to architecture decisions and Jira backlog.
  • Collaborate with the open-source community by reviewing pull requests and following the project’s contributing guidelines.


Qualifications


Required

  • Strong proficiency in Go (1.16+; 1.23+ preferred) with experience building production backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB (or comparable NoSQL databases) and designing performant data models.
  • Solid understanding of REST, RPC, and WebSocket APIs.
  • Experience with Docker for containerization and basic Kubernetes deployment knowledge.
  • Comfortable writing tests and following clean-code practices (linting, modular architecture).


Preferred

  • Previous work with game replay parsing, binary data formats, or large-scale data processing pipelines.
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems, background workers, or microservices.
  • Exposure to machine-learning model integration or analytics platforms.
  • Interest or experience in esports, competitive gaming, matchmaking systems, or blockchain/Solana integrations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (not required).
  • Located in Brazil or available for overlapping hours with a Brazil-based team.


Nice-to-Have

  • Contributions to open-source Go projects.
  • Knowledge of post-quantum cryptography or advanced security practices.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Jira, or similar tools used by the team.


What We Offer

  • Direct impact on an open-source product that is shaping the future of competitive gaming analytics.
  • Work alongside a small, passionate team that values quality code and rapid iteration.
  • Flexible remote setup with Brazil-friendly hours.
  • Opportunity to grow into senior/lead roles as the platform expands.

title: Especialista em Plant Simulation (PJ)
description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna.
  • Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0).
  • Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças.
  • Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM).
  • Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter (Essencial):

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation .
  • Domínio de programação em SimTalk .

and deployment.

Camel).

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

description:

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.

You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.

  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
